title: External Application Accuracy Contract Canonical Admission and Temporal-Indicator Binding Review

authority.canonical_stage: F-CI43P current canonical postimage at preregistration

purpose: Determine whether the isolated F-GC09 runtime/coupler application-accuracy contract seam is safe and semantically complete enough for canonical admission against the current F-CI43P postimage, without introducing any numeric application policy or silently assigning model-specific temporal-indicator semantics to the generic canonical carrier.

live_postimage_observation.carrier_contract: generic model-owned temporal-indicator budget; canonical runtime and F-KT transaction core attach no physical units or estimator semantics; selected model owns interpretation and must normalize its native indicator into the dimensionless F-KT09 certificate surface
live_postimage_observation.F_GC09_native_budget: H_app_cm * A_temporal, therefore a head/drawdown-domain budget in cm
live_postimage_observation.unit_conclusion: cm is not intrinsically incompatible because the generic carrier is deliberately unit-agnostic
live_postimage_observation.open_admission_question: whether the current canonical coupling/model layer contains an explicit, testable binding between this cm budget and the native temporal indicator/certificate normalization that consumes it

admission_gates: GC09 source must remain compatible with the current canonical contract blob without schema mutation
no hidden positive fallback budget and no stale budget survival
head/drawdown native units and selected model indicator semantics must be explicitly bound before the generic budget can control transaction acceptance
the model-owned normalization to the dimensionless F-KT09 certificate surface must be explicit and testable
no application-policy provenance may leak into kernel persistent state
mass conservation remains absolute and independent of head-accuracy policy
no production MODFLOW coupling claim may follow from admitting the seam
fail_closed_rule: If the current canonical postimage does not provide an explicit coupling/model consumer that interprets the materialized native head/drawdown budget and normalizes the corresponding native temporal indicator into the F-KT09 certificate surface, F-GC10 must close blocked. The dormant F-GC09 seam remains independently qualified but is not promoted by this workunit.
